comparison_prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: visual direction comparison board for Batwalk, an Apple Watch cozy walking-and-bat-pet game.
Primary request: create one beautifully art-directed landscape comparison board showing THREE clearly different redesign directions, equally polished. Three equal columns on a warm neutral paper background, each with one large close-up rounded-rectangle Apple Watch display, no watch bands, and one enlarged matching bat character underneath. Use the SAME readable home layout in all displays: small header "Batwalk"; a large adorable round bat centered; bottom clean card with text "Mochi", small label "961 steps to hatch", and one subtle progress line. Keep watch typography compact and clear, mostly white on dark surfaces. No overlapping text. Each screen realistic at watch size and generously framed.
Column 1 caption "A · Soft storybook": softly sculpted matte clay/toy illustration, a tiny round milk-tea-colored bat with oversized soft ears, short curved wings, simple black shiny bead eyes, rosy cheeks, cream belly, subtle hand-made organic curves. Quiet deep evergreen watch background, muted sage accents, warm ivory cards, restrained soft illumination. Charming editorial children's storybook, minimal finish rather than glossy 3D game render.
Column 2 caption "B · Clean illustration": warm contemporary flat illustration, clear rounded silhouettes, charming graphic milk-tea bat, consistent thin cocoa outline, large simple eyes, subtle cheeks, no texture. Quiet charcoal-green background, sage and warm cream accents. Crisp modern illustrated mobile game, beautifully understated.
Column 3 caption "C · Gentle pixel": authentic uniform coarse pixel grid, highly readable 32–48px-style bat silhouette, restrained palette of warm beige, cocoa, dusty mint, no micro-detail, a few clearly deliberate pixels for eyes and cheeks. Quiet midnight-teal background, minimal small moon, warm cream typography, slate-sage cards. Elegant cohesive indie handheld-game aesthetic.
Composition: high-end product design presentation, three distinct styles readily comparable, watch screens dominate, soft clear typographic labels outside screens, generous breathing room.
Constraints: The bat is the central subject in every style. No neon glow, no glassmorphism, no dense stars, no big background moon behind the header, no confetti, no gold trim, no extra app features or figures, no horror, no watermarks. Exact captions and home text only. This is a concept board, not an existing code screenshot.

assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production transparent pixel-art sprite sheet for Batwalk, Apple Watch cozy bat-pet game.
Input image 1: STYLE REFERENCE ONLY, ONLY the rightmost "C · Gentle pixel" column. Ignore the left and middle columns and all UI/text.
Primary request: a 1536x1024 PNG arranged in a STRICT 3-column x 2-row grid of six equal 512x512 cells. No drawn grid/labels. Each cell shows one whole cute BAT sprite on actual transparent background. Use a REAL uniform coarse 64x64 logical pixel grid in each cell, rendered at 8x nearest-neighbor. Every visible square pixel is aligned to this same 8px grid. Each character occupies approximately 44x44 logical pixels centered within the cell, fixed foot/base logical y=55. Hard crisp pixel edges, 12–16 colors maximum per character, NO smooth gradients, anti-aliasing, micro-pixels, fuzz, painterly texture, 3D fur, glossy clay, vector outline, or atmospheric aura.
CHARACTER: MOCHI BAT: warm oat-beige round sleepy mascot, soft cocoa brown scalloped bat wings, warm cream oval belly, rounded pointed ears with muted peach insides, tiny cocoa nose and rosy cheek pixels, immediately lovable. Medium ears about one-third of body height.
Top row NORMAL palette as described. Bottom row SHINY palette: dusty mint-sage body, cream belly, muted moss wings, pale peach ears. Same species silhouette and unique defining feature, deliberate variant colors, no particles or glow.
Columns: 1 asleep, closed simple 2-pixel eyes, wings folded; 2 awake, small friendly simple dark eyes with one ivory highlight pixel, wings partially open; 3 happy, curved smiling eyes and tiny open smile, wings open.
Design: visually match the rightmost reference's warm rounded chubby 48px-style character, sweet understated cheeks, clear tiny feet and scalloped BAT membrane wings, no whiskers or tail. The silhouette and identifying feature stated for this species are essential; don't merely recolor a generic mascot. Keep fixed scale/base in all six cells.
Constraints: GENUINE alpha transparency behind and between each sprite; no backdrop, RGB matte, ground plane, floor shadow, halo, floating stars, UI, captions, props beyond the described defining feature, watermark, borders, or extra figures. All bat ears and wings must remain fully inside their cell with >=5 logical pixels clear margin. Exactly six separate sprites, same character across moods and variant.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: Batwalk production pixel-art item sprite sheet.
Input image 1: Mochi pixel sheet, STYLE REFERENCE ONLY. Match its coarse, warm, gentle pixel aesthetic.
Create one 1536x1536 PNG, STRICT 4x4 equal-cell grid. Exactly one pixel item per cell on a genuinely transparent background. No grid lines, labels, backdrop, floor, shadows, halos, glitter, words or watermark. Use chunky readable 32–48 logical pixel silhouettes on a 64x64 logical canvas per cell, sharp nearest-neighbor edges, simple limited palettes, no fine detail. Each icon centered with generous clear transparent margins.
There are 15 eggs plus one strawberry. Same modest egg silhouette/size in every egg cell. Egg is a rounded organic oval with a narrower top and 2px cocoa/slate outline; each type has one simple motif:
Starter: warm cream/oat shell, two small peach spots.
Tiny: dusty sage shell, pale cream dots.
Forest: muted moss-green shell, one small cream leaf motif.
Moon: muted slate-blue shell, small cream crescent.
Crystal: pale blue-gray shell, one simple lavender diamond.
Calm state: whole shell. Cracked state: one clear small zigzag dark crack across middle, shell still closed. Ready state: larger zigzag crack with a narrow warm cream/gold opening, no loose shards or aura. No eyes or faces on eggs.
EXACT row layout, left to right:
Row 1: Starter calm; Starter cracked; Starter ready; Tiny calm.
Row 2: Tiny cracked; Tiny ready; Forest calm; Forest cracked.
Row 3: Forest ready; Moon calm; Moon cracked; Moon ready.
Row 4: Crystal calm; Crystal cracked; Crystal ready; a single muted coral-red strawberry with sage green leaves and three cream seed pixels.
All 16 items wholly contained inside their own cell, centered, fixed scale/base across egg states. Keep background actual alpha 0, not a checkerboard or painted neutral.
